image_description: A close-up, front-facing view of a lionfish (Pterois) swimming in an underwater environment. The fish displays characteristic red and white vertical stripes, large fan-like pectoral fins extending laterally, and elongated dorsal spines rising from the top of its head. The background consists of blurred coral reef structures in reddish and brownish tones.
